owner_and_capability: Enrollment — parent intake (submission, edit, withdrawal, renewal confirmation, status link, form loads, late invites, manual approved enrollment) and the change requests with their review list in modules/enrollment, published as enrollment.IntakeSubmissions, IntakeStatus, IntakeForms and ChangeRequests (#3565); services/enrollment is deleted
atomic_cutover: The intake and change-request flows move from services/enrollment into the Enrollment application with no second provider; the retained package, its enrollmenttest helper and its goldens are deleted. Settings, random bytes, fingerprints, People Directory rows, reviewer names and the outbox reach the application through ports services binds; bookings go through Care Plan's offering booking commands; every write keeps the ambient tenant transaction. api/enrollment decodes the raw public values for its handlers and the parents portal.
tests: The intake, change-request, form-visibility, eligibility, legal-block and status-token unit suites run in modules/enrollment/internal/application, the selection rule suites in modules/enrollment/selection, against fakes of the new ports.

The intake, change-request, decision, rollover, restore, deletion, phase, form-schema, two-tenant and n+1 query budget suites run in api/enrollment and compose the flows through api/testutil the way the root does.
The care-offering catalog, offering change, offering adjustment, offering source and arrival/pickup projection suites run in modules/careplan/contracttest.
scripts/backend-architecture.sh check and scripts/test-changed.sh verify the architecture ratchet and affected packages.

runtime_evidence.source: The PR on the #3565 branch after the intake and change-request cutover. The PR description records the local architecture, lint, vet and changed-package test runs; the evidence is behavioral and structural, not a latency benchmark.
runtime_evidence.workload: Affected Go package suites against the local PostgreSQL test database, the moved unit suites and source-level architecture checks.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No new forbidden import, rule or composition target; the 45 listed legacy keys retired; the moved suites retain their assertions and scripts/backend-architecture.sh check passes.

affected_rows.reason: This cutover changes implementation ownership and bindings, not the schema or row-update statements; every write keeps its columns and transaction.

query_count.result: The n+1 query budget suites run unchanged against the composed flows with their scenario names.

latency_p50.reason: No latency benchmark was run for this code relocation; no new network round trip was added.

latency_p95.reason: No latency benchmark was run for this code relocation; no new network round trip was added.

errors.result: The moved suites pin the intake and change-request error texts; the public sentinels mirror the retained texts and mark selection and Care Plan refusals so errors.Is keeps matching.

pool_wait.reason: No connection-pool configuration or acquisition path changes.

lock_wait.reason: No lock is added or reordered; the submission dedup lock, the request-before-children lock order and the offering row locks are unchanged.

deadlocks.reason: No lock order changes were intended or measured in this code relocation.

job_duration.reason: The retention cleanup and the rollover deadline worker keep their scheduler bindings and statements.

failure.result: The unit suites cover missing bindings, rate limits, eligibility refusals, stale change-request snapshots and the companion stranding batch refusal.

rollback.reason: No schema or data migration accompanies this code cutover; reverting the PR restores the former service implementations and bindings.

smoke.result: scripts/backend-architecture.sh check passed locally at 468 legacy keys with a composition surface of 607.

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert the PR as a unit to restore services/enrollment and its bindings. No data cleanup is required.
exit_criterion: backend/services/enrollment no longer exists; intake and change requests run through modules/enrollment; the 45 listed legacy keys are absent, no new key or rule is added, and validate-ticket --all --base-ref accepts their retirement.
